reviewers.scope: All eight shared modules, 80 shared questions, 48 cards, eight scenarios/17 decisions; Scrum Guide authority. Baseline report returned in chat before interruption.
All eight applied modules, 80 applied questions, supplemental scenario/card claims; recovered draft revalidated after interruption.
All 25 published exam-focus rows; independent bounded review of material corrections and four revised coverage questions.
Integration, official exam/preparation/conduct rechecks, source metadata reconciliation and final targeted verification.

authorityPolicy: Current English Scrum Guide governs Scrum rules. Official Scrum.org articles support named supplemental concepts and situational practices. May 2024 EBM Guide is a separate framework. Reading lists and collections guide study, not precise proof of every claim.
limits: AI source review, not Scrum.org approval or a guarantee of completeness/pass probability.
Fictional examples and consequences illustrate choices; the cited principles do not prove the invented outcomes.

Topic coverage is introductory and practice depth varies. Vision and Business Strategy each have one direct question. Module-balanced random rehearsals may omit a specific focus-area question; use the topic practice and official resources.
No live exam questions, recollections or dumps were inspected. Original question provenance is an authoring claim, not an independent plagiarism/dump comparison.
Section names are supplied without invented anchors when stable anchors were not checked. Blocked retrievals were not used as claim proof.
Accessibility/device checks are separate from this content audit.
